analysis.title: GS - Feiler - Consumer 6 Stocks in Focus - 27 Oct 2026
key_insights: RCL reported its 2nd solid cruise print in the last month (CCL printed 9/29). 3Q net yield was +0.6% and the company remains committed to an acceleration into the mid 4's in 4Q. Investors focused on 4Q and 2027 commentary, and both were constructive.

RCL says it will have a $20 handle on 2027 EPS. Consensus is $20.32, which implies +14% growth. Bookings and rates are ahead of historical levels. The desk was better to buy cruise stocks yesterday from LO.
HLT shares are -4% pre-market and the GS trading desk is better to sell early. The stock had moved from $300 to $350 over the last month into the print, so the bar was high.

HLT fundamental pushback is that flow-through to the bottom line was underwhelming for a 2nd straight quarter, with single-digit EBITDA growth again. Investors also raised 3Q flow-through and the 4Q guide as small issues.
HLT consumer health looks solid, with +7% US RevPAR in 3Q. 4Q is guided a little below that, and the question is whether the guide is conservative, which has been the case for much of this year.

KO had another solid quarter, with best in class organic revenue growth of +7% and 170 bps of gross margin upside. The nitpicks were North America at +3% vs consensus +4% and LatAm driving a bulk of the upside.

KO was at an all-time high until Thursday of last week. Investors are asking about valuation (27x) and what the upside is at these levels. KO price action will be read as a gauge for other high-bar staples names.

ROST rose on an upgrade, but there were numerous comments about slowing data in the off-price category. Investors have the most confidence in a ROST beat for 3Q, with more questions around BURL's trends.

OLLI is a preferred name that has lagged for the last 2 weeks (stock -$10) on feedback about slower data to end 3Q. Conversations for much of the quarter were with investors looking for clear upside to 3Q SSS consensus.

DG fell hard midday on headlines that the FTC sued DG for alleged deceptive pricing. Investors say such headlines have not been a major issue for stocks in the past. The space was weak and a big underperformer yesterday. Investors expect 3Q upside, and the question is the durability of the recent top-line outperformance.
